panel_description_zh: 中景平视，妻子把手机屏幕递给李斌看（手机举到画面中央）；手机屏幕显示会员续费页面；妻子脸 3/4 侧面；表情不耐烦（眼瞟别处、眉中拱、嘴微张）。

dialogue_or_narration.speaker: 妻子
dialogue_or_narration.text_zh: 去吧去吧去吧，别耽误我看剧了，对了给我每个月几个会员都续上啊，最近我要看一部巨好看的剧，曾舜晞帅死了。

prompt_en: Chinese modern comic style, contemporary urban realism, soft cinematic lighting, naturalistic proportions. Eye-level medium shot of a 30-something East Asian Chinese woman holding a black smartphone in rose-pink silicone case out toward the off-frame husband, the screen facing the camera showing a streaming service subscription renewal page. Face shown in three-quarter side view. Impatient done-with-this expression — eyes looking away from the husband toward the phone or the TV, classic lost-interest eye direction not quite rolling but pointedly elsewhere, eyebrows slightly raised in the middle in a done-with-this arch (not angry), mouth slightly open with exhaled breath through parted lips, lips relaxed but jaw set, no active scolding happening. Long straight black hair completely down around her shoulders, single pearl stud earring, small gold locket at neckline. Fitted cream ribbed long-sleeve knit top, fresh nude-pink gel manicure visible on the hand holding the phone. Warm yellow-white living room light. Mood: the new assignment, a small additional demand tagged onto the evening. Text watermark 'P14-PN01' in the bottom-right corner.
negative_prompt_en: anime proportions, full frontal face shot, smiling, husband visible in the frame, decorative hallway art, daylight from a window, second character, bloodshot eyes, romantic soft lighting, dramatic shadows

render_constraints_check.character_anchors_referenced_inline: 妻子 wardrobe_default + face_features（长直黑发完全散 + 珍珠耳钉 + 锁骨链 + 裸粉美甲 + rose-pink 硅胶手机壳）+ 妻子_不耐烦 expression_signature（眼瞟别处 + 眉中拱 + 嘴微张）
